title: Redstone Optimization
description: A simple modpack aim to create a smooth, lightweight and convenient redstone gameplay experience.
body:
**Redstone Optimization** is an modpack designed for Minecraft 1.20.1 that prioritizes performance, stability, and essential tools for technical gameplay. It brings together a carefully selected set of optimization mods and quality-of-life utilities, allowing players to enjoy complex redstone contraptions and large‑scale farms even on modest hardware.

# Key Features

**Optimized for Low‑End Systems** – By including only lightweight performance mods such as Sodium, Lithium, and FerriteCore, along with fine‑tuned configuration files, the pack significantly reduces memory usage and increases frame rates. It is tested to run smoothly on integrated graphics and older CPUs.

**Essential Technical Mods** – Pre‑packed with useful utilities for redstone players: Litematica for schematic placement, MiniHUD for real‑time information overlays, Tweakeroo for fine‑grained control, and JEI for item recipes. There are also two redstone relevant resourcepacks.

**Clean And Lightweight** – No unnecessary performance waste. Every mod included serves a clear purpose: either improving performance or enhancing the technical play experience. 


# 

**Redstone Optimization** is the ideal choice for technical Minecrafter players who want a smooth, responsive experience on any machine, allowing you to focus on engineering rather than frame drops.
